_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Whoever is not against us is for us.
The Spirit blows where it will.
Would that all God's people were prophets!
Would that the Spirit rested on us all!
Have salt in yourselves;
and be at peace with one another.
Come, let us worship the God of fire and savor.
We come to be salt for the world. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Once Moses cried, Would that all the Lord's people were prophets, that God would put the Spirit on them all — and so God has, on you.
Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace.
A cup of water given in his name is not forgotten; even the smallest kindness is counted and kept.
Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace.
You are the salt that keeps the world from spoiling, the fire on the hearth that does not go out.
Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace.
So pray for one another, lift up the ones who are hurting, and come to worship the God who revives the soul.
Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Whoever is not against us is for us.
Salt and peace among us.
Even a cup of water given is remembered.
Salt and peace among us.
Have salt in yourselves; do not lose your savor.
Salt and peace among us.
Come, let us worship and pray for one another.
Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace. Amen.
